title: Computed background positions, repeatable-list interpolation, and CSS declaration representation

New declaration getter exposed old important axis records after explicit shorthand replacement.

attempts.remaining_blocker: Permitted forward observation: important x-axis followed by normal shorthand leaves a stale important axis in specified serialization.

attempts.composition: Accepted dc7bae76 HEAD plus position-only; sizing118 runtime excluded/restored. Pending sizing HTML/CTest registration is non-runtime metadata.
attempts.scope_narrowing: Public getPropertyValue/getPropertyPriority methods restored byte-for-byte to acceptedHEAD, independently verified by ops. Native computed values, normalization, repeatable-list interpolation, shared easing, and complete shorthand set/remove remain. Partial declaration-model reconstruction is excluded.

resource_bounds.pathological_behavior: Explicit discrete fallback with exact endpoints; no unchecked numeric LCM growth.

native_validation.candidate119_helper_preflight: 69 checks:11 arithmetic/resource,16 shared easing,23 declaration representation,19 mutation methods; one test-extraction wrapper syntax error was corrected before the passing run.

paint_cost_evidence.interpretation: Display-list/layout test, not rasterization. Source composition differs by font optimization; this is a bounded CPU/wall diagnosis, not a pure position comparison or broad performance claim. Prior234-second wall duration occurred under contention.

rendering_evidence.limitation: Numeric/list serialization and interpolation do not establish multilayer or gradient rendering support; renderer remains first-layer only.

known_limitations: Two mixed logical-axis list expectations remain unresolved draft-spec/test/reference differences; uniform logical origin preservation restores four singleton baseline passes. Chromium150 does not support the logical keywords.
Twenty-seven Chromium nonpasses in the main cohort include twelve logical-keyword cases and fifteen computed list-cardinality differences.
New independent12-case geometry/interpolation fixture upload was denied and unexecuted; it was not retransmitted or reconstructed.
Separate reverse-axis setter browser observation upload was denied and unexecuted; it was not retransmitted or reconstructed.
Preexisting mixed-priority computed background-position failure remains explicit.

Source-level architectural analysis, not paired observation: attribute-backed declaration storage cannot fully represent partial-axis mutation/removal of a pending shorthand with mixed priorities. Complete shorthand replacement/removal is corrected; partial expansion remains outside this scope.

accepted_evidence.forward_observer: Unscored: full shorthand20px20px restored, all priorities cleared, computed positions20px20px; specified derived x/y remain empty under accepted legacy getter semantics.

surrendered_candidate_only_behavior: The richer priority-aware public getter was removed. The frozen CSSOM diagnostic changed from candidate117:9/10 to accepted candidate120:7/10; baseline remains6/10. Two unaccepted candidate-only passes were surrendered with zero baseline losses.
comparison_composition_limit: The actual independent gate baseline is114, which predates the accepted font optimization. Accepted candidate120 contains font plus position, while sizing is excluded. Earlier candidate116 excluded font and independently showed the identical482→1192/1299 (+710) main gain, with the same adjacent/shared/grid outcomes, supporting attribution of those gains to position. No pure position-on115 paired comparison is claimed. Geometry will use a new combined accepted121 baseline.

portable_regression.interpretation: Regression protection only: seven selected already passing callbacks from full10, not seven additional gains or independent coverage. The full10 remains7/10 with three unresolved cases.
portable_regression.wrapper_failures: Three invalid wrapper attempts retained; marker prefix and original loop closure bindings corrected without changing callback bodies or expectations.
